description_en: Lists the Skills in your account
description_zh: 分页查询当前账号下的Skill列表
name: ListSkills

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return per page
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求返回的最大条数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next page of results. Omit this for the first request. For subsequent requests, set this to the `NextToken` from the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 分页 Token。首次查询不传；后续查询传上一次返回的 `NextToken` 获取下一页
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The search keyword for a fuzzy match on Skill names
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，按 Skill 名称模糊匹配
parameters.name: q

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by visibility level. You can specify multiple values
parameters.help_zh: 按可见性级别过滤，可传多个
parameters.name: visibility
